ja: 掃除機、いつもの場所に戻してくれる？
en: Could you put the vacuum back where it belongs?
alternatives: Can you put the vacuum back where it usually goes?
Could you return the vacuum to where we usually keep it?
point: 「〜する場所」は where + 主語 + 動詞で後ろから修飾

ja: 私がやるべきは洗濯物をたたむこと。
en: What I should do is fold the laundry.
alternatives: What I need to do is fold laundry.
The thing I should do is fold laundry.
point: What I should do is の後は動詞の原形で OK

ja: 姉は洗剤を買いに行ったよ。
en: My sister went to buy detergent.
alternatives: My sister went out to buy detergent.
My sister went to get detergent.
point: 目的の「〜しに」は to + 動詞の原形で表す

ja: 彼女がうんと言ってたら、今ごろ食洗機があるのに。
en: If she'd said yes, we'd have a dishwasher now.
alternatives: If she'd agreed, we'd have a dishwasher by now.
If she'd agreed to it, we'd have a dishwasher now.
point: 過去の仮定は had + 過去分詞、今の結果は would have

ja: 一番上の棚に届かないんだ。
en: I can't reach the top shelf.
alternatives: I can't reach the highest shelf.
The top shelf is too high.
point: 一番上の棚は特定の棚なので the top shelf と the をつける

ja: 弟はもうアイロンがけできるよ。
en: My brother can iron now.
alternatives: My brother can iron clothes now.
My brother can already iron.
point: can の後ろは動詞の原形で irons にしない

ja: 疲れてても、お椀くらいすすいでくれる？
en: Even if you're tired, please rinse your bowl.
alternatives: Tired or not, could you rinse your bowl?
Even when you're tired, can you rinse your bowl?
point: 「〜てても」は even if。although にしない

ja: フィルター、先月から掃除されてないよ。
en: The filter hasn't been cleaned since last month.
alternatives: Nobody has cleaned the filter since last month.
The filter hasn't been cleaned for a month.
point: since があるので現在完了の受動 hasn't been cleaned

ja: ママが電話してきた時、お風呂掃除してた。
en: I was cleaning the bathroom when Mom called.
alternatives: When Mom called, I was cleaning the bathroom.
Mom called while I was cleaning the bathroom.
point: 途中だった動作は過去進行形 was cleaning で言う

ja: 土曜、みんなでガレージを掃除するよ。
en: We're cleaning the garage this Saturday.
alternatives: We're going to clean the garage Saturday.
We'll clean the garage this Saturday.
point: 決まった予定は現在進行形でも言える

ja: 兄は先週の日曜、午後ずっと草むしりしてたよ。
en: My brother spent all last Sunday afternoon pulling weeds.
alternatives: My brother was out pulling weeds all last Sunday afternoon.
My brother spent last Sunday afternoon weeding the yard.
point: 「〜して過ごした」は spent + 時間 + -ing の形

ja: 弟に部屋を片付けるよう言ってくれる？
en: Can you tell him to clean up?
alternatives: Could you tell him to tidy up?
Can you ask him to clean up?
Will you tell him to clean up?
point: tell + 人 + to do の語順。that 節にしない

ja: お母さん、牛乳がもうないよ。
en: Mom, there's no milk left.
alternatives: Mom, there isn't any milk left.
Mom, we have no milk left.
Mom, we're out of milk.
point: milk は数えられないので a をつけず no milk とする

ja: 洗濯機が止まったら、干してくれる？
en: When it stops, can you hang the laundry?
alternatives: Can you hang the laundry when it stops?
Could you hang the laundry once it stops?
point: when 節は未来のことでも現在形 stops のまま

ja: リサイクル、出してもらってもいい？
en: Do you mind taking out the recycling?
alternatives: Could you take out the recycling?
Would you mind taking out the recycling?
point: mind の後は動名詞。to take にしない

ja: 洗濯物を干す前に、天気予報を見ればよかった。
en: I wish I'd checked the forecast first.
alternatives: If only I'd checked the weather first.
I should have checked the forecast first.
point: 過去の後悔は wish の後を過去完了 I'd checked にする

ja: 冷蔵庫の牛乳、賞味期限切れてるよ。
en: The milk in the fridge has expired.
alternatives: The milk in the fridge is expired.
That milk in the fridge is expired.
point: 「冷蔵庫の牛乳」は in the fridge を milk の後ろに置く

ja: 一緒にガレージを片付けたいなと思ってて。
en: I was hoping we'd clean out the garage.
alternatives: I was hoping we could clean out the garage.
I was thinking we could clear out the garage.
point: I was hoping で控えめに誘う。中身ごと片付けるは clean out

ja: ねえ、掃除機がどこにあるか知ってる？
en: Do you know where the vacuum is?
alternatives: Any idea where the vacuum is?
Do you know where the vacuum cleaner is?
point: 間接疑問は where the vacuum is の語順

ja: 頭にくるのは、ルームメイトが皿はもう洗ったと言い張ること。
en: What drives me nuts is her insisting the dishes are done.
alternatives: What gets to me is her insisting the dishes are done.
What really bugs me is her insisting the dishes are done.
point: 「頭にくるのは〜」は What drives me nuts is ~

ja: 僕は料理好きだけど、片付けは本当に面倒だよ。
en: Although I enjoy cooking, cleanup is a hassle.
alternatives: I like cooking, but cleaning up is a pain.
Cooking's fun, but cleaning up is such a chore.
point: 「〜だけど」は although か but。両方は重ねない

ja: もっと早く電話してれば、お湯が使えたのにね。
en: If we'd called sooner, we'd have had hot water.
alternatives: If we'd phoned earlier, we'd have had hot water.
We would've had hot water if we'd called sooner.
point: 過去の仮定は if 節が had + 過去分詞、主節は would have

ja: 父は網戸を直すと言ったのに、まだ手つかずだよ。
en: Dad said he'd fix the screen but hasn't started.
alternatives: Dad said he'd fix the window screen, but hasn't started.
Dad said he'd fix the screen, but hasn't touched it.
point: 言ってた内容は would、「まだ」は現在完了で hasn't started

ja: エアコンは先週、業者に掃除してもらったよ。
en: The AC was cleaned by professionals last week.
alternatives: We had the AC professionally cleaned last week.
Professionals cleaned the AC last week.
point: エアコンを主語にするなら was cleaned と受け身にする

ja: 夫はゴミ出しを忘れたけど、もう出したよ。
en: My husband forgot, but he's taken it out.
alternatives: My husband forgot, but he's already done it.
My husband forgot, but it's out now.
point: 忘れたのは過去形、今は済んだ状態なので現在完了

ja: ゲーム前に、子どもたちに片付けさせてる。
en: We make the kids tidy up before gaming.
alternatives: We have the kids tidy up before gaming.
We make our kids clean up before gaming.
point: make + 人 + 動詞の原形。to は付けない

ja: パパ、ガレージ何週間も後回しにしてるよ。
en: Dad, you've been putting off the garage for weeks.
alternatives: Dad, you've been avoiding the garage for weeks.
Dad, you've been putting the garage off for weeks.
point: 今も続く「ずっと〜してる」は have been -ing、for で期間
